title: ZimAgritrust Certified Field Agent Examination

questions.text: What is the primary mission of the ZimAgritrust platform in the Zimbabwean agricultural value chain?
options: A) To provide free fertilizers to all farmers
B) To connect farmers directly to buyers with secure escrow and agent verification
C) To manage government grain reserves
D) To sell mobile phones to rural communities
questions.rational: ZimAgritrust eliminates middlemen and secures payments through escrow.

questions.text: When is the buyer's payment released to the seller in the ZimAgritrust Escrow system?
options: A) As soon as the buyer places the order
B) When the agent confirms the crop is in transit
C) Only after both buyer and farmer confirm delivery
D) 30 days after the harvest
questions.rational: Escrow ensures both parties confirm delivery before funds are released.

questions.text: What are the visual indicators of Maize Lethal Necrosis (MLN) that an agent must log during field verification?
options: A) Bright purple stalks
B) Chlorotic mottle on leaves and necrosis starting from the margins
C) Deep green leaves with white spots
D) Excessive root growth

questions.text: Which ML algorithm is primarily responsible for the AGRINET anomaly detection layer?
options: A) Linear Regression
B) Isolation Forest
C) K-Nearest Neighbors
D) Naive Bayes
questions.rational: Isolation Forests are used for fraud anomaly detection.

questions.text: Under the Agricultural Marketing Authority (AMA) Act, what is the mandatory requirement for agents handling tobacco contracts?
options: A) Personal bank account and 5 years experience
B) Registration with the AMA and a valid ZimAgritrust Certification
C) A commercial truck and warehouse access
D) Proof of land ownership
questions.rational: Legal compliance is central to the platform's legitimacy.

grading_policy: Strict. 80% required for field deployment status.
